- Official release archives are SHA-256 checked before extraction. Official Plugin entr"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"y artifacts and auxiliary assets are release-pinned with SHA-256 SRI.
- Managed Web App upstreams mu"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"st be exact loopback HTTP origins. User-supplied endpoints and LAN/native upstreams are rejected.
- "},{"id":"p36s5","text":"Liveware receives only an opaque upstream lease. Core keeps Plugin authority, Activation Generation "},{"id":"p36s6","text":"fencing, Binding credentials, and managed-resource retirement.
- Managed Web Apps own their authenti"},{"id":"p36s7","text":"cation. Core does not inject ClawChat identity, cookies, credentials, or Session state into them.
- "},{"id":"p36s8","text":"Private Liveware publication remains owner-only, but the exposed App retains its own security model."},{"id":"p36s9","text":"
